name: Distiller
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Distiller and have them choose 2 alive players. Then put them to sleep and either put a good Potion on one of the chosen players, or remove an evil potion from one of the chosen players.
ability: Each night*, choose 2 alive players; 1 receives a good potion or 1 of their evil potions break.
flavor: Ein Glas ist fabelhaft, zwei sind zu viel, und drei zu wenig.
